feats.title: Magic of the Ages
feats.description: When you use your memory of a thousand lifetimes racial power to add to the attack roll of an arcane power, you gain a +1 bonus to the triggering roll.

feats.title: Astral Elixir
feats.description: Shielding Elixir also grants radiant resistance of the same value and duration as its usual resistance. Its target may end the effect as a free action when making a saving throw to add 1d6 to that save, replacing the usual benefit for ending the elixir.

feats.title: Astral Enmity
feats.description: When Memory of a Thousand Lifetimes boosts an attack against your Oath of Enmity target, that attack also deals extra damage equal to the bonus rolled.

feats.title: Astral Preservation
feats.description: Using Preserver's Rebuke gives allies within 2 squares +1 to all defenses against bloodied attackers for the rest of the encounter.

feats.title: Immortal Warding
feats.description: Swordmage Warding stays active while you are unconscious. Its AC bonus also increases both resistances from your Astral Resistance trait by that amount.

feats.title: Memory of a Thousand Battles
feats.description: After a reliable fighter power misses all its targets, you may expend Memory of a Thousand Lifetimes to reroll all of that power's attack rolls.

feats.title: Shared Memories
feats.description: As a free action, expend Memory of a Thousand Lifetimes to add 1d6 to an adjacent ally's attack roll, saving throw, or skill check.
